resource.name: OutReign API
resource.description: Pay-per-call agent access to OutReign lead enrichment, ICP scoring and AI email generation.

resources.description: Enrich a single lead with contact and company data.
Score a lead against the account's ICP profile.
Generate a researched cold email for a lead.

fallback.description: Agents acting for a signed-in OutReign user can use the account's plan credits with an X-API-Key instead of per-call payment.
